items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Crack Stanley was an old, old trumpet player, much older than me. His nickname was acquired because he was a real crack shot at hitting high notes.

ctx.x: Crack Stanley was an old, old trumpet player, much older than me. His nickname was acquired because he was a real crack shot at hitting high notes. Bing bing. So he acquired the name of Crack Stanley. I used to think it meant because he cracked notes, but I was told that he really popped them notes.
